record.title: Rule 6A-14.0719, F.A.C., Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) Policies in Florida College System Institutions
record.issuing_body: Florida State Board of Education (Department of Education)
record.summary: New State Board of Education rule requiring the board of trustees of each Florida College System institution to adopt policies on the use and limits of use of AI, to ensure quality of education, efficient operations and a safe learning environment. The policies must cover compliance with privacy, copyright and other laws; notice to parents of enrolled minors who will directly use an AI instructional tool; academic integrity, barring AI use on graded work unless the instructor permits it; approved AI instructional and business tools; and an AI literacy framework. Tools designed to meet students' social needs or to simulate friendship or companionship are not AI instructional tools.
record.notes: A notice of rule development was published on 27 May 2026 and the proposed rule on 25 Aug 2026, with a hearing before the State Board of Education on 16 Sep 2026, at which the Board adopted the AI rules; no notice of change was published. The rule was filed with the Department of State on 30 Sep 2026 and takes effect on 20 Oct 2026. It incorporates by reference the U.S. Department of Labor's Training and Employment Notice 07-25, the AI literacy framework that institutions may consult. Each institution must reflect the policies in its manuals, handbooks and forms for students, employees, contractors and guests. The companion amendment to rule 6A-1.0957 sets AI safety requirements for school districts and charter schools.

verification.note: Stored from flrules.org (the Florida Administrative Code and Register site of the Florida Department of State): the rule page for 6A-14.0719, with the effective date and notice history (development, proposed and final notices, no notice of change); the final notice, with the rule file date (30 Sep 2026) and effective date (20 Oct 2026); and the Florida Administrative Register issue of 25 Aug 2026 with the notice of proposed rule, the full text and the hearing date. Also stored the Department of Education press release of 16 Sep 2026 (fldoe.org) saying that the State Board adopted the AI rules, including those for Florida College System institutions, that day. The summary follows the proposed text, which the rule page shows was adopted without a notice of change. Neither flrules.org nor fldoe.org is yet listed in pipeline/official-sites.json.

judgment.status_reasoning: The final notice gives 'RULE FILE DATE: 9/30/2026' and 'RULE EFFECTIVE DATE: 10/20/2026', and the rule page the history note 'History–New 10-20-26'. 20 Oct 2026 is after today (14 Oct 2026), so the rule is adopted but not yet in force. Status: 'Adopted, not yet in force', date_in_force 2026-10-20. date_published is the rule file date with the Department of State; the Board's vote of 16 Sep 2026 is in the notes.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope with no scope_note: a binding state rule that is AI-specific and requires public colleges to adopt AI governance policies, including parental notice for minors and the exclusion of companion-style AI from instructional tools.
judgment.summary_reasoning: The summary follows the proposed text in FAR Vol. 52 No. 165; the rule page lists no notice of change between the proposed and the final rule. Defined terms are rendered as the rule gives them ('artificial intelligence instructional tool', which excludes tools designed to meet a student's social needs or simulate friendship, companionship or an emotional relationship).
judgment.related_reasoning: C012 (amendment to rule 6A-1.0957) is the companion State Board of Education rule for school districts and charter schools, heard at the same Board meeting.
